scope: Ten synthetic transport groups only; no actor/cohort or image-interface measurements.

policy.entryUrl: origin plus original normalized bundle-relative entryPath; never rename entry HTML
policy.csp: default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline' 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
policy.compare: exact decoded RGBA; any channel difference makes one changed pixel; dimensions must equal
policy.repeatIdentity: same coordinates, dimensions and decoded RGBA for every accepted page/tile; refusal reason and zero reader captures equal across runs
policy.cleanup: context/browser closed for every public/private success/refusal; failed capture bytes retained outside reader scope
policy.source: controller manifest drawn only from frozen participant finished-delivery records/explicit attachments, no new owner action, sibling crawl, author explanation, session context or arbitrary file/network fallback

pngDecoder.api: PNG.sync.read; compare decoded RGBA exactly, no tolerant comparator

browser.versionProvenance: Previously measured V2.2 frozen runtime; require actual matching version and executable hash at later V3 qualification, no V3 launch yet.

left.html: Before after

right.html: Before after

delivery.html: Sticky label
SAFE

pivot: Any subcase failure, changed expectation, unexpected resource failure or unequal repeat rejects candidate; return to planning, no post-result corpus adaptation.

admissionAmendment.reasonForSix: Unavailable delivery has two separate raw controls: omitted field and explicit null; neither may use the looseCandidate.
admissionAmendment.productionContract: Exercise the real production admission path on raw delivery field presence/value without coalescing, assigning defaults or selecting looseCandidate. Omission remains absent/undefined and null remains null. Preserve actual raw presence/value in the owner receipt.
admissionAmendment.mandatoryFields: Delivery evidence/manifest, explicit assets array (which may be empty), original entryPath and frozen htmlSha256 are mandatory. Compare observed main bytes to the frozen expected hash; never compute a replacement expectation, rebind identity, infer an attachment or select/default an entry.
admissionAmendment.cleanup: Each new raw admission case refuses with zero reader captures, no remaining owned context/browser, and closed-or-never-created lifecycle receipts. No actual actor access is permitted by this registration.
